card.name: Risk-phrase endings in warning text
card.fires_on: The last word of a named adverse condition inside a risk or warning sentence, such as the ending of tardive dyskinesia or the word depression after worsening of. Also 'with' after superinfections.

modes.label: End of tardive dyskinesia
modes.description: The final piece of the word dyskinesia in the statement about risk of developing it and its becoming irreversible.
modes.example: The risk of developing tardive dyskines<<ia>> and the likelihood that it will become irreversible

modes.label: Condition after worsening of
modes.description: The condition name depression following worsening of, in suicidality warnings.
modes.example: either the worsening of<< depression>> and/or the emergence of suicidal impulses has

modes.label: Other risk nouns
modes.description: A word completing a hazard phrase, such as superinfections with or accidental exposure.
modes.example: The possibility of superinfections<< with>> mycotic or bacterial pathogens should be
